details:
On 2026-05-18 every release tag of actions-cool/issues-helper (53 tags) was moved to new unsigned commits whose composite action.yml installs Bun, runs an obfuscated index.js, and then calls the real action so the step still passes. The payload is the Mini Shai-Hulud worm (attributed to TeamPCP in MAL-2026-4161): on GitHub-hosted runners it reads the ghs_ GITHUB_TOKEN and other secrets from Runner.Worker memory, exfiltrates to t.m-kosche[.]com, and uses the token to commit .claude/ and .vscode/ autostart hooks that run the payload on developer machines, where it installs the kitty-monitor backdoor and a wiper that fires when the stolen token is revoked. GitHub disabled the repository on 2026-05-19, re-enabled it on 2026-09-16 with the tags unchanged, and disabled it again on 2026-09-25; tag references ran the payload again in that window (ant-design/pro-components run 35952487396 resolved v2.2.0 to 896379ed and pushed the worm as commit 1bc4049d). Treat any workflow that used this action by tag since 2026-05-18 as compromised; full commit SHAs of releases that predate 2026-05-18 are unaffected and are not listed here.

Affected versions. `versions` lists the 50 fixed release tags and the 53 commits that all 53 tags resolved to after the move (the floating tags v1, v2 and v3 are not valid OSV versions, so they are covered by their target commits 5c267592, 3480e51e and 147337a9). The tag-to-commit list below shows which `versions` entries are tags and which are the commits they resolve to. Source: the ecosyste.ms GitHub Actions index, which recorded all 53 tags pointing at commits dated 2026-05-18 (https://packages.ecosyste.ms/registries/github%20actions/packages/actions-cool%2Fissues-helper). Independently confirmed mappings: v2.2.0 -> 896379edfaac994ff214a3097c6c82e21be16066 (CyberXYZ, Actions run log), v2.2.1 -> a0c53dd42fc842d2f9276c5a1d4f9a26abe8713d (Socket), v3 -> 147337a919d92f4bf42f02843682d694650f1e22 (SafeDep published the prefix 147337a919d9).

Tag -> malicious commit (first 12 characters; full SHAs are in `versions`): v1 5c267592a87e, v1.1 a7156495f340, v1.2 203671479d66, v1.3 e778a401e233, v1.4 15dc537110a4, v1.5 cfbd14ccc97a, v1.6 3904fe935f1a, v1.7 710ff89debb1, v1.8 8a64710bb8fe, v1.9 9793761b1bc3, v1.10 6a538e928b88, v1.11 cd96d6518c63, v1.12 67716d94ad07, v2 3480e51eec2b, v2.0.0 75fb02043af2, v2.1.0 601e1296a5a0, v2.1.1 d2877f69bae9, v2.1.2 9bd6ce03e0c2, v2.2.0 896379edfaac, v2.2.1 a0c53dd42fc8, v2.3.0 edf8cf78d6fe, v2.3.1 55253d49c681, v2.4.0 071e169dfb36, v2.4.1 46eff1378ad0, v2.4.2 3f4d68048127, v2.4.3 91b26b99c50a, v2.5.0 e9631d2e615d, v3 147337a919d9, v3.0.0 b9c83f01929e, v3.0.1 d9b1764cbe78, v3.1.0 64ed6d61b6ee, v3.2.0 85c9d842e1c0, v3.2.1 a7d3c46a3556, v3.3.0 15c89f718cd3, v3.3.1 fa6a4ca487f2, v3.3.2 459b0cfc4dd7, v3.3.3 3846bd4230da, v3.4.0 dc5687b71897, v3.5.0 4b69521f9829, v3.5.1 8cc2629c5681, v3.5.2 419b34c60362, v3.6.0 e0585c103662, v3.6.1 4bb72d31eaee, v3.6.2 257849272e29, v3.6.3 03bbf452b52f, v3.7.0 aa44b5492c78, v3.7.1 8a3a7c2960ff, v3.7.2 4b10341e2313, v3.7.3 aeb05195dbd6, v3.7.4 aea87833045e, v3.7.5 abc4310e6b85, v3.7.6 f0448c62fc57, v3.8.0 1c9e803c80cc.

files.note: Obfuscated Bun payload run by the hijacked action.yml (500,143 bytes, git blob 2931c1be43b0d04174636ddbff54963aec92bdeb). The worm copies it to .claude/index.js in victim repositories.
Loader the worm commits to victim repositories; downloads Bun 1.3.14 and runs .claude/index.js.
kitty-monitor backdoor installed on developer machines (not on CI runners).
